title: Wood Kiln Rental — Full Kiln, 2026 & 2027
source_quote:
2026 Full Wood Kiln Rental
All full kiln rentals for 2026 have been booked.
Click Here to view 2026 dates
evidence_sentence: The page offers full kiln rental for experienced groups who can manage the entire firing process independently.
evidence_quote: Those interested in renting the full kiln must have experience in loading and firing wood kilns. At least one individual within the group needs to be able to load the kiln with confidence.
summary: Groups with wood-firing experience can rent the entire noborigama kiln for $2,250. Your group manages loading, firing, and unloading independently, with the Wood Kiln Instructor present for guidance. 2026 rentals are fully booked; 2027 registration opens on specific dates per month.
how_to_join: 2027 registration opens monthly; see page for details
